absolute_scale_features.log_rule: natural log only for strictly positive energy; zero remains unavailable
absolute_scale_features.normalization: none; native and R1 common-trace descriptors remain in source units

input_sampling_rate_rule: consume R1 output_sampling_rate_hz; current R1 candidate is 10 Hz
input_units: phase_like_radian; absolute displacement equivalence not claimed

normalized_shape.normalization: band PSD bin power divided by total positive respiratory-band power
normalized_shape.zero_band_power: typed unavailable; no epsilon fake vector

reference_rule: reference channels are engineering diagnostics only and cannot tune this candidate

respiratory_band.interpretation: bounded engineering candidate; not a clinical cutoff and not validation-tuned

sign_rule: preserve source sign; no sign flip; spectral power/autocorrelation descriptors are sign-invariant

welch_method.band_integration_rule: sum(PSD bins in band) * frequency resolution
welch_method.short_trace_rule: trace length < 64 samples is typed unavailable; no padding or interpolation
